# Insureon

> > Insureon provides instant online business insurance quotes and coverage, helping small businesses find and purchase policies from multiple carriers.

Insureon is an online insurance agency specializing in small business insurance, offering instant quotes, policy comparisons, and educational resources. The platform simplifies the process of finding general liability, professional liability, workers' compensation, and other commercial insurance products.

## Key Topics

- Small business insurance
- Instant online quotes
- General liability insurance
- Professional liability insurance
- Workers' compensation
- Insurance premiums and costs
- Policy declarations page
- Underwriting and risk assessment
- Admitted vs non-admitted carriers
- Subrogation
- State department of insurance (DOI)
- National Association of Insurance Commissioners
- Business coverage options
- Insurance agency services

## Getting Started

- [Buy Business Insurance: Instant Online Quotes](https://www.insureon.com/?legacy=bin&action=new): Homepage for Insureon's online business insurance quotes and coverage

## Insurance Glossary & Fundamentals

- [What Is a Business Insurance Premium?](https://www.insureon.com/insurance-glossary/premium): Defines insurance premium and its role in business coverage costs
- [What Is Underwriting in Business Insurance?](https://www.insureon.com/insurance-glossary/underwriting): Defines underwriting and risk assessment in business insurance
- [What Is a Declarations Page in Business Insurance?](https://www.insureon.com/insurance-glossary/declarations-page): Explains declarations page role in business insurance policies
- [What Is Subrogation in Business Insurance?](https://www.insureon.com/insurance-glossary/subrogation): Explains subrogation process and claims reimbursement rights
- [What Are Admitted vs. Non-Admitted Insurance Companies?](https://www.insureon.com/insurance-glossary/admitted-vs-non-admitted-insurance-carriers): Compares admitted vs non-admitted carriers and state regulations
